prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story.
Edit ONLY the attached reference image. It is the user's explicitly chosen five-panel watercolor comic version. Deliver ONE revised horizontal 16:9 static comic image, same resolution/aspect and same story scenes, same beautiful artwork, watercolor, colors, wide aged parchment channels and outer margin. There are TWO requested changes, both must be obvious.

CHANGE 1 — SHARPER, MORE STRONGLY SLANTED COMIC PANEL BOUNDARIES:
Keep FIVE images with the same general reading order and structure: top-left walking along wall; top-right spirit sees distant greenhouse through leaves; lower-left arriving at gate; lower-middle crossing under gate; lower-right large first-level garden scene.
Make the diagonal divisions noticeably more forceful and ACUTE than the original. The original panels are only mildly leaning near-vertical trapezoids, separated by an almost horizontal center channel. Redesign their geometric CUTOUT SHAPES using much more oblique diagonal cuts and a dramatic angular central parchment channel.
Specifically lean the long diagonal between the two top images by approximately 40–45 DEGREES AWAY FROM VERTICAL (currently around 20 degrees). Lean each lower diagonal separator by approximately 35–45 degrees away from vertical, with varied directions/angles rather than repeated gentle parallel slants. Connect the slanting row boundary in an off-center bent zigzag so the gutters meet in visibly sharp acute angles, around 25–40 degree wedge corners. The main split should look like an intentional sweeping angular comic cut, NOT an almost-horizontal ruler line and NOT a rectangular grid. Make the panel height endpoints visibly staggered. Retain readable substantial areas for all five scenes; don't create unusably thin slivers.
Maintain the same generous clean PALE PARCHMENT WIDTH between all panels, roughly 2.5–3 percent of image width. Thin sepia outlines, no thick black seams. Exactly five panels, no fragments or extra insets. No torn edges.
This is changing panel masks and their borders, NOT tilting/rotating the content inside them. The spirit stays upright, the ground remains level in each scene, buildings and gates remain upright. Preserve the subject framing and content as much as possible, extending the painting at edges only as needed. Do not replace the illustrated gate or invent new subjects. Keep the final panel large enough for the whole existing game-level composition.

CHANGE 2 — SHRINK ONLY THE SPIRIT IN THE LOWER-RIGHT FINAL PANEL TO EXACTLY HALF ITS CURRENT SIZE:
Identify the small glowing ivory spirit immediately inside the LEFT gate in the LOWER-RIGHT large garden scene. This is the ONLY character to resize.
Scale this particular whole character to 50 PERCENT of its ORIGINAL WIDTH AND 50 PERCENT of its ORIGINAL HEIGHT. This is one quarter of its old screen area. Do not merely reduce size by 20 percent; the result must be visibly half as tall. Approximate original full head-to-feet extent is around 80 pixels at the reference's 1672 x 941 resolution; target about 40 pixels, including its main flame-head silhouette but excluding detached glow particles.
Anchor the scaled figure at the SAME FOOT CONTACT POINT on the mossy platform just inside the left gate, relative to the same nearby steps and wall. Feet stay on the ground. Preserve facing right, original pose, exact flame-head proportions, oval dark eyes, little body and golden chest core. Shrink the local character glow proportionally. Naturally repaint the old space vacated above and around the now-smaller character with the existing wall/moss background. Do not leave a ghost or larger duplicate behind.
DO NOT shrink the garden or zoom out the whole scene. All first-level background landmarks remain at their original scale and proportions: left gate and stone steps, red/ivory ivy wall and canopy, center mirror/lantern post, right steps with the pale scale-shaped tail and terracotta pot. Only this one character becomes half size.
Keep the character size in ALL FOUR OTHER PANELS unchanged.

INVARIANTS:
Use THIS supplied version as the edit target. Preserve all five of its depicted scenes, including the existing complete first-level panorama in the last panel. Do not replace the last scene with a new tail closeup or a different narrative camera shot. Do not redesign the gates or change the number of panels. No new objects, people, dialogue, labels, watermarks, numbers or typography. Same illustration style, melancholy watercolor twilight in the approach shots and warm garden colors in the last. Same old creamy parchment storybook material. High-quality selective edit, not wholesale regeneration. The two visible improvements should be sharply angled panel geometry and a clearly half-size spirit in the final scene.
scope: 以本轮用户新附图为唯一修改底稿：加锐折线，仅末格角色宽高缩至50%。
